scope: cumulative observables depending only on the set-valued trace family T_t(R_1) under the graph-discrete-space free-union/intersection filtration
statement: The degree-zero free-union layer already realizes every subset of the fixed row, so the entire cumulative fixed-row trace filtration is constant and any baseline-subtracted coordinate determined only by that family has zero positive-degree signal.
does_not_obstruct: joint traces on multiple coupled rows
cheapest_regression: Verify T_0(R_1)=P(R_1); monotonicity then forces T_t(R_1)=P(R_1) for every t.
